body: **Findings from the master (Gate 1 run, 2026-10-24)** — none fixed, reported for the maintainer:

**Findings from `worker-35` (#35):** (1) no root `README.md` in `micelio-engineering`, although standard section 1 lists it for every repository; #35 asked for a link from it, so the link went to `AGENTS.md` instead. (2) Confirms the 1.5 → 1.6 version clash for #45 reported above.

**Finding from `worker-36` (#36), for the pilot (#43) and the planner:** the first `lint-issue` run on the nine issues of "Builder, fase 1 — Vista previa" found that 8 of the 9 have no "Out of scope", and bogd3v/micelio-plugin-core#41 also has no Delivery section. The reports will be in the #36 pull request (`packages/factory-tools/test/fixtures/builder-fase-1/`).

**Finding from `verifier-35` (#35), outside this milestone:** `npm run verify:template` fails on `main` at `a5952e1`: `[warn] .github/labels.json` / `Code style issues found` / `Error: Command failed: npm run check`. `template/.github/labels.json` (added by #32) is not Prettier-formatted.
